evaluation_scope: PlantVillage dataset-level image classification; not field validation.

split_method.independent_test: One held-out fold from 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold over both published color manifests, grouped by inferred leaf_id. The published manifests share inferred leaf groups and are not used directly as independent splits.
split_method.validation: One fold of 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold over the grouped training partition, grouped by leaf_id.

limitations: PlantVillage uses controlled-background leaf images; field photos may differ substantially.
Predictions are limited to the supported dataset classes and do not establish diagnosis in real crops.
The confidence threshold is not a calibrated probability of correctness.
The dataset card declares CC BY-SA 3.0; the upstream GitHub repository does not publish license metadata. Review attribution/share-alike obligations before redistribution.
